name: Can replacing a door sweep help with soundproofing?

mainEntity.name: Can replacing a door sweep help with soundproofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing an old or ineffective door sweep can contribute to improved soundproofing, especially for exterior doors. A properly sealed door minimizes gaps where sound waves can pass through, thereby reducing outdoor noise infiltration. While a door sweep primarily focuses on thermal and pest sealing, its ability to create a tighter seal also has the practical tradeoff of improving the acoustic insulation of your door, offering a quieter indoor environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing a door sweep improves soundproofing by sealing gaps where noise can enter, offering a quieter indoor environment alongside thermal benefits.
